title: N24 homepage: choose the direction
question: Logo A and palette 1 stay fixed. This decides how the homepage is built around them.

options.label: The coast road
options.lineage: Jadranska magistrala (D8) strip maps and km stones
options.thesis: Your 8 areas sit in exact order on one road, Vodice to Rogoznica, so the coast itself becomes the search.
options.viewport: A full-width sea photo above an edge-to-edge strip map of the coast with 8 stops (Vodice, Srima, Šibenik, Brodarica, Žaborić, Grebaštica, Primošten, Rogoznica), each with its listing count. Tap a stop and the listings below filter to it. Type chips and a Search button sit on the strip.
options.risk: The strip must stay readable on phones, where it scrolls sideways as a coast ribbon.

raised.raise: Red is reserved for what matters now: the selected stop, the price and the one primary action. Nothing else is red.
One long horizon band: the coastline strip runs edge to edge and every section aligns to it.
Distances and prices set in tabular figures, like km stones: 12 km to Šibenik, 300 m to the sea.

options.label: The cadastral sheet
options.lineage: Croatian katastarski plan and parcel survey drawings
options.thesis: The red frame is a plot boundary; every listing is a parcel with its number, area and outline.
options.viewport: A sand-colored survey sheet with fine parcel outlines across the page; the headline sits inside one red-framed parcel, the search bar in the title block, featured listings as numbered parcels.
options.risk: Speaks loudest to land buyers; house buyers may find it technical. It is also close to where many agency sites go.

options.label: Glazier's partition
options.thesis: Listings as panes in a black glazing grid.
options.viewport: A wall of panes, one lit per listing.
options.case: Buyers don't connect a glass wall to a coastal home; the color-per-pane system fights the pinned palette.
options.risk: Reads as an art piece, not an agency.
options.kept: Red only for what matters now.

options.label: Indoor weather sun
options.thesis: One vast horizontal band of light.
options.viewport: A half sun on a horizon line.
options.case: Amber monochrome erases listing photos and the pinned palette.
options.kept: One long horizon band as the page's spine.

options.label: Collider event display
options.case: No buyer identifies with a detector; too abstract for listings.

options.label: Torn flyer wall
options.case: Undermines trust for a purchase this size.

options.label: Algorave floor
options.viewport: A code buffer at stage scale.
options.case: No connection to buyers or property.

options.label: Massin stage page
options.case: Too theatrical for search and enquiry tasks.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A big photo hero with a search box, then a featured listings carousel, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-screen sea-view photo, headline and search box on top, featured listings below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every agency site, including today's N24 and Sotheby's.
